assessment.detail: Default prints actions_executed=false/state=INCOMPLETE without capture or Docker CLI read. Requested runner arguments retain per-call timeout <=10, remaining 30-second budget, stdin None, 1MiB returned-output limit and PATH-only environment. capture_limits.authorization: No --capture-once or actual capture performed or authorized by this review. A CLI flag is not operator authorization.
capture_limits.timing: 30 seconds is measured from capture function entry. Initial source/CLI/file preflight is not interrupted by the alarm, though elapsed time is subtracted from remaining budget. Final observation persistence occurs after alarm cancellation. No whole-process wall-clock guarantee.
capture_limits.attempts: Exactly two inspections on the successful acquisition path, no third/repeat. native_inspections counts attempted runner calls, not independent proof of completed inspections.
capture_limits.output: Default runner rejects oversize returned stdout after subprocess capture; limit=1MiB is not claimed as a complete streaming/heap-memory cap.
capture_limits.shape: READY_FOR_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW is only provisional pair evidence. The wrapper's limited shape/equality check is not full Snapshot/identity/image/config validation or accepted-baseline derivation.
capture_limits.state: Sequential selected-field equality is not atomicity, continuous state, health, exact restoration or installed-byte proof.
capture_limits.reuse: Inherited standalone SIGALRM/main-thread/error/persistence boundaries are retained, not a new broad cancellation/timer-composability audit.
capture_limits.next_inputs: Actual paired metadata must be strictly reconciled offline and independently reviewed. Material unexplained drift must not be silently adopted; no prepared IDs or accepted Plan exists now.
